segments.name: Development and commercialization of innovative medicines
segments.description: Develops and commercializes medicines for underserved neurological and rare disease communities, led by NUPLAZID for Parkinson's disease psychosis and DAYBUE for Rett syndrome.
segments.evidence: The Company has determined that it operates as a single business segment, which is the development and commercialization of innovative medicines .

revenueModel.text: Customers, substantially all in the U.S., pay the company for net product sales of NUPLAZID and DAYBUE dispensed through specialty pharmacies, distributors and wholesalers.
revenueModel.evidence: Revenues consist of net product sales to customers, substantially all of which are sales in the U.S.
